import { log as logger } from "@warlock.js/logger";

export async function placeOrder(id: number) {
  // keep this comment
  await logger.info("orders", "place", `Placing ${id}`);
  const result = await saveOrder(id);
  await logger.success("orders", "place", "Placed", { id });
  logger.warn("orders", "slow", "Slow save").then(() => notify(id));
  await logger.flush();
  return result;
}

declare function saveOrder(id: number): Promise<number>;
declare function notify(id: number): void;
